review_text: The headphones arrived on time. Pairing with my phone took less than a minute, and the ear cushions are comfortable. The case is a little bulky.
I use these on my daily commute. Noise cancellation reduces the train rumble and I can still hear announcements when I turn on the transparency setting.
Sound quality is good for podcasts. The microphone picks up wind outside, so I switch to my phone for calls. Reasonable for the price.
Battery life has been close to the advertised figure over my first week. The buttons are easy to find without taking the headphones off.
The headband presses against my glasses after about an hour. I liked the sound but returned them because the fit did not work for me.
Bought these for studying in a shared room. The background fan becomes much quieter, and I can wear them for an afternoon without discomfort.
Switching between my laptop and phone works well. There is a short pause when a call comes in, but the connection has been stable otherwise.
The bass was stronger than I expected. Lowering it in the equalizer helped. The app is straightforward, although the first firmware update was slow.
The left ear cup stopped playing after four days. I tried a different phone and reset the headphones before requesting a replacement. Support replied the next morning.
Used them on a three-hour flight. They stayed comfortable, and the battery indicator barely moved. The included cable was useful with the seat audio socket.
The hinge feels solid and the cushions are easy to wipe clean. I would have preferred a fabric pouch instead of the hard case.
Fine for music at my desk. There is noticeable audio delay in one of my games, so I use the wired connection for that.

The replacement cushions fit securely and the headphones fold neatly into the case. I have used them for video calls all week without connection problems.
Good separation between vocals and instruments. The clamping force eased after a few days. I usually listen at low volume and cannot hear much leakage.
They do what I need for work calls. I wish the microphone had a physical mute button. The app setting takes an extra step to reach.
Packed well and arrived with a partial charge. The connection remembers both of my devices. The voice prompts are louder than I would like.
A useful upgrade from my wired set for walking and listening at home. The controls still work with gloves, and I have only charged them twice this month.
Comfortable for a short session, but the cushions get warm after a long meeting. Sound and battery life are fine. I would choose a lighter pair next time.
